claim: The speed ratio of 28 MHz to 3.5 MHz differs by game and by routine (wait states against contention), so measure the factor per game, and per routine when a fast window is used.

evidence.text: JNext 28 MHz ran routines only 5 to 6.5 times as fast; BE38 5.0 to 6.0 by strip, E656 about 6.2, C05A about 6.6.
K 6.75 was calibrated on JNext only; the hardware value is still open.
Simulated 28 MHz T times 8/6.5 turned 13 simulated overruns into 128 hardware ones in 1,043 frames (inferred from board figures, not measured on this game).
